data.headline: Late 10-K filing highlights Estelle Project’s future permitting requirements

claims.text: The EDGAR record lists an NT 10-K filing dated 2026-09-29.
The Estelle Project’s existing exploration-related authorizations cover hard-rock exploration, water use, fish habitat and fish passage, and camp operations.

citation.quote: The Estelle Project’s existing exploration-related authorizations include permits and authorizations administered through the APMA process relating to hard-rock exploration, water use, fish habitat and fish passage, and camp operations.

claims.text: Future development of a mine and processing facilities at Estelle would require additional permits, approvals and authorizations.

citation.quote: Future development of a mine and processing facilities at the Estelle Project would require additional permits, approvals and authorizations.

claims.text: The potential approval requirements include mine and reclamation plans, air quality, wastewater and stormwater discharges, water rights, wetlands, and other federal, state and local requirements.

citation.quote: These may include approvals relating to a mine plan and reclamation plan, reclamation financial assurance, air quality, wastewater and stormwater discharges, solid waste and tailings management, water rights or temporary water use, wetlands, fish habitat and passage, rights-of-way and other infrastructure, cultural resources, dam safety and other applicable federal, state and local requirements.
